UNFOLDING THE SOLAR PANEL
=========================

1. Take the solar panel out of the storage bag.
2. Unfold the solar panel step by step as shown in the illustration.
3. Open the two support stands on the back of the solar panel.
4. Adjust the panel to face the sun, then connect it to your portable power station.

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/js100i_eu_en/unfold_steps_1_3.png
   :alt: Steps 1 to 3: remove the panel from the bag, unfold its four sections, and open the two support stands.
   :width: 100%

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/js100i_eu_en/unfold_step_4.png
   :alt: Step 4: face the unfolded panel toward the sun and connect it to a portable power station.
   :width: 100%
